description: This file defines functions and constants for fetching, caching, and parsing RSS feeds as part of the MagpieRSS PHP library. It includes the core fetch_rss() function, error handling, debugging, and internal utility functions, as well as setup for cache management and HTTP response processing.

classes.name: Snoopy
classes.description: An HTTP client class used for retrieving remote files, including RSS feeds.

classes.name: MagpieRSS
classes.description: Class used for parsing RSS data and handling RSS feed objects.

classes.name: RSSCache
classes.description: Class implementing caching logic for RSS feed data.

methods.name: fetch_rss
methods.description: Fetches and parses an RSS feed from a URL, utilizing cache if enabled.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Sets an error message and triggers a warning.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debugging messages if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: magpie_error
methods.description: Getter and setter for the current error message.

methods.name: _fetch_remote_file
methods.description: Internal function to retrieve a remote file via HTTP using Snoopy.

methods.name: _response_to_rss
methods.description: Converts an HTTP response object into an RSS object, extracting ETag and Last-Modified headers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes default configuration constants for cache, timeout, and user agent.
